title: Permission Coexistence Orchestration — Shadow Sync, Audit Preservation, and Tenant Opt-In Communications
creator: Aisha Patel
body:
Objective: Transition Redwood's permission model from RBAC v1 to RBAC v2 with minimal customer impact. Provide a coexistence strategy that runs RBAC v1 and v2 in shadow-sync (dual-read, shadow-write) mode, preserves audit continuity, supports SSO/SAML mappings, and offers a tenant opt-in path for early adopters.

Background: RBAC v2 introduces a normalized permission ledger, explicit role bindings, and richer admin controls needed for Private deployments and Dedicated customers. Past migrations saw friction around missing audit continuity and surprises from role remapping. This ticket defines an orchestration approach that focuses on safety, observability, and clear tenant-facing comms.

Scope:
- Implement shadow-write (v1->v2) with reconciliation pipeline that ensures eventual parity.
- Instrument audit logs to include canonical identifiers for both v1 and v2 events.
- Provide a tenant opt-in flow (console + API) to migrate individual orgs on their schedule.
- Develop rollback-safe controls and throttles for backfills and reconciliation jobs.
- Produce communications and runbooks for Support/Customer Success.

Non-goals: Complete auto-cutover of all customers; deep SAML attribute remapping automation (will be a follow-on).

Approach:
1) Shadow Sync Design: dual-read in API layer, write-to-both on a controlled path. Writes go to v1 authoritative store and an append-only v2 staging feed. Reconciliation workers consume staging feed and apply idempotent operations to the v2 ledger.
2) Audit Preservation: enrich audit entries with fields: legacy_permission_snapshot, v2_delta_id, reconciliation_trace_id. Add a compatibility view in the Console that shows historical actions mapped to v2 roles.
3) Tenant Opt-in: Console checkbox + API field (migrate=true). Opt-in triggers a bounds-checked backfill, a preflight diff, and a scheduled switchover window. Opt-in also creates a migration ticket in our internal tracker for Support.
4) Safety Guards: rate-limited backfill, reconciliation checkpointing, a pause-and-resume facility, and a per-org circuit breaker (auto-fail to v1 reads on repeated reconciliation errors).
5) Observability: dashboards for reconciliation lag, reconciliation error rate, permission delta distribution, and sample audit entries. Alerting on >1% delta for high-volume orgs.

Acceptance criteria:
- Dual-write path deployed to staging and exercised with synthetic tenants.
- Reconciliation worker processes 100k operations/hr with <0.5% failure in staging.
- Console shows unified audit view for a migrated tenant with historical continuity.
- Tenant opt-in flow available in Console and documented in the customer migration FAQ.
- Rollback plan validated in a dry-run against a synthetic tenant.

Runbook (high level):
- Preflight: run migration-audit-diff for tenant; validate expected deltas < threshold.
- Backfill: start backfill worker with throttle=10r/s; monitor reconciliation-lag dashboard.
- Switchover: flip tenant read-path to v2 canonical after backfill successful and stakeholder signoff.
- Post-switchover: 72h elevated monitoring; run periodic integrity checks.
- Abort: use per-tenant circuit breaker to revert reads to v1; run repair job to clear partial application in v2.

Rollback mechanics:
- Reconciliation jobs are idempotent; each write has a reconciliation_trace_id.
- We maintain tombstones and a v2 staging buffer to undo partial state by replaying v1 canonical stream up to a checkpoint.
- Manual operator command: rbac-migrate revert --tenant <id> --checkpoint <ts>.

Customer communications (draft snippets):
- Email subject: "Action required: Optional permissions migration to improve admin controls"
- Body excerpt: "We’re offering an opt-in migration to a new permissions model that enables finer-grained admin controls and better auditability. No action required unless you choose to opt in — early migration gives you access to advanced admin features and support for Private deployments."
- Console banner copy: "Try the new Permissions model (Opt-in). View migration preview and schedule a migration window."

Artifacts and links:
- Design doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/rbac/permission-coexistence-design (draft)
- Reconciliation worker PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rbac/pull/987 (WIP)
- Console opt-in UI mock: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/perm-optin-mock
- Synthetic tenant scripts: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/tree/main/migration-tests

Stakeholders:
- Product: Maria Svensson (product manager)
- Security: Daniel Kaur (security lead)
- Console eng: Priyanka Rao (owner for opt-in UI)

Open questions / decisions required:
- Final threshold for allowed delta pre-switchover (proposal: 0.5% for orgs < 10k users, 0.1% for larger orgs).
- Policy for default opt-in (initially will be opt-in only; decision required for auto-migration for trial orgs).

Compliance note: The enriched audit data must be retained at parity with existing retention policies. Coordinate with Legal for any retention policy exceptions.

Next steps (short term):
- Complete PR for reconciliation worker and get security review (ETA 2025-03-07).
- Implement console opt-in mock and run usability session with CS (scheduled 2025-03-11).
- Run first synthetic dry-run and produce runbook checklist (owner: Ethan).
progress_updates: 2025-02-13: Kickoff meeting with Security/Product/Console. Agreed on opt-in approach and audit enrichment fields.
2025-02-20: Reconciliation worker prototype can apply idempotent ops from staging feed; initial perf of ~70k ops/hr in small instance.
2025-02-27: Console PM reviewed opt-in flow mock; requested adding a migration preview showing expected permission deltas.
2025-03-03: Security review requested (ticket sec-2025-314). Need signoff on audit schema changes before staging deploy.
2025-03-04: Reconciliation PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rbac/pull/987. Pending code review (ENG-ops assigned: S. Martinez).
notes_for_support: Provide Support with a migration-preview tool that outputs a human-readable diff. Add an internal KB article with step-by-step opt-in/resolution steps and escalation path to engineering-runbook.
review_feedback: PM review (Maria): add 'migration-preview' in Console before allowing opt-in.
Security review (Daniel): ensure audit entries include both legacy and v2 identifiers; block staging deploy until schema migration is finalized.
